atoms.text: Renewable energy comes from sources that can’t be used up and is not only more sustainable, but important for the future. There are three main types of renewable energy. Hydropower, also known as water power, uses hydro plants to get energy from rivers and dams and is the most used type of renewable energy. Solar power converts energy from the sun into electricity using solar panels, which can also be installed onto the roof of a house, for example. Wind energy is collected in wind turbines, which you can often see at the side of the road when driving down the motorway.
